documentation.xlink:title: NCAR GDEX - WACCM-X SD 2 Degrees Output 2000-Present(d654001)

metadata.documentation: This dataset is output from simulations using the Whole Atmosphere Community Climate Model with Thermosphere and Ionosphere eXtension (WACCM-X) for years from 2000 to near present day. The horizontal resolution is 1.9 degrees in latitude by 2.5 degrees in longitude. The model vertical extent is from the surface to the upper thermosphere, approximately 600 kilometers depending on solar cycle. The lowest 50 kilometers of the model is nudged with Modern-Era Retrospective analysis for Research and Applications, Version 2 assimilated observations. This WACCM-X dataset can be used to study individual events since year 2000 and decadal changes throughout the atmosphere. It can also be useful in Artificial Intelligence training and related studies.
